text: こら　カホ　ぼく　ばっか　みてたら　ダメだぞぉ

structure.jp: ぼく　ばっか　みてたら
structure.en: if you look only at me

patterns.name: 〜たらだめだ
patterns.span: みてたら　ダメだぞぉ
patterns.explanation: たら means 'if', and with ダメだ 'no good' it means 'you mustn't'. みてたら is the short spoken form of みていたら. みてたら ダメだ = 'you mustn't keep looking'.

patterns.name: 〜ばかり
patterns.explanation: ばかり after a word means 'nothing but that'; ばっか is its casual form. ぼく ばっか = 'only me'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end of a sentence is a manly way to warn or push a point; the drawn-out ぞぉ makes it playful and sweet here. ダメだぞぉ = 'that's a no-no, you know'.
